answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, the "saffron" protocol employs a reputation-based system, where agents verify one another's identities by exchanging "nectar" - a unique digital signature - to establish trust. This process is akin to navigating the ocean of interactions, where agents must collectively ensure that no single entity can create multiple, fake identities. By requiring agents to prove their "saffron" credentials, the system discourages malicious actors from creating multiple fake identities, thus resisting Sybil attacks and maintaining the integrity of the economy.
